itemList.description: The proposed Petting Zoo for the Dasara Exhibition 2025 Childrens Play Area will be a secure, interactive enclosure designed to allow children to safely interact with domesticated and gentle animals such as rabbits, guinea, Parrots goats, sheep, calves, chickens, ducks, and miniature ponies etc The zoo area will span approximately 1,000 TO 2,000 square feet, divided into multiple pens and themed zones based on animal types. The entire space will be fenced using child-safe PVC coated mesh fencing (minimum 4 ft. high) with a single gated entry/exit point manned by trained staff. The ground will be covered with soft natural turf, straw bedding, or anti-slip rubber mats to prevent injury and maintain hygiene. Shade structures or UV protected tents will be installed to protect both animals and visitors from sun and rain. Each animal pen will include access to clean water, shaded rest areas, and feeding troughs. A hand washing station with soap, running water, and signage on hygiene will be placed at the exit. Signboards with animal names, care tips, and fun facts will be displayed for educational value.Staffing will include a minimum of 2 TO 4 trained handlers or animal care specialists, one security personnel, and volunteers to monitor visitor behavior. The zoo will operate under standard animal welfare guidelines, including daily health checks, proper feeding schedules, and a vet on call. A veterinary clearance certificate will be mandatory before bringing animals on site. Safety measures include banning loud noises, sudden movements, or food from outside. Timed entry in small groups will ensure animal comfort and prevent overcrowding. The entire area will be cleaned multiple times a day, with weekly deep sanitization during the exhibition period. Optional features include pony rides (with extra safety gear), a small bird enclosure, or storytelling corners themed around farm life. This petting zoo will serve as a safe, educational, and memorable experience for children, enriching the Dasara festivities with a close-to-nature attraction. Supplying of food to the animals, Watching and taking care of animals etc., till the end of maintainance from inaguration of Exhibition-2025 to end of the Exhibition-2025.
